about.intro_content: Prof. Yuan-Fang Li is a Professor in the Department of Gastric Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, treating gastric cancer, pancreatic cancer, and soft tissue neoplasms.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Li has served as senior/corresponding author on multiple studies in gastric cancer, including a pooled analysis of 29 clinical trials examining the predictive value of radiological and pathological response for overall survival in neoadjuvant immunotherapy, published in the European Journal of Cancer. He has also contributed to landmark trials evaluating perioperative immunotherapy combined with chemotherapy for locally advanced gastric or gastro-esophageal junction cancer, published in Nature Medicine.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Yuan-Fang Li

items.question: Does Prof. Yuan-Fang Li accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to gastric, pancreatic, or soft tissue cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Li's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Li specialises in the surgical treatment of gastric cancer, pancreatic cancer and soft tissue neoplasms, with a research focus on immunotherapy response prediction.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Is Prof. Li involved in clinical trials for gastric cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Li has contributed to landmark perioperative immunotherapy trials in gastric cancer and led research on predictive biomarkers for immunotherapy response.

items.question: Does Prof. Li treat cancers beyond the stomach?
items.answer: Yes. In addition to gastric cancer, Prof. Li treats pancreatic cancer and soft tissue neoplasms as part of a broad abdominal surgical oncology practice.
